 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill the inside of a framed rectangle with alternating square rings
    centered on the interior marker (the non-frame 3)."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    top = min(r for r, c in frame_cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in frame_cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in frame_cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in frame_cells)
    interior_markers = [(r, c) for r in range(top + 1, bottom) for c in range(left + 1, right) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if len(interior_markers) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly one marker inside the frame")
    mr, mc = interior_markers[0]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            d = max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2)
    return out
"
